Watch-only wallet export and hardware signer fingerprint

- To restore a missing master fingerprint, scan the original hardware wallet public account QR again and select the matching account. Your existing wallet and its history are retained.
- Wallet Export keeps the fingerprint and derivation path with Native SegWit public accounts. Copy confirms success and the public export remains pasteable after switching apps.
- XBT Native SegWit PSBTs include the complete signer fingerprint. XBT external signing requires firmware that supports XBT Unified signatures.
